security_problem: Untrusted MCP metadata can steer a call to a process that reuses an allowed logical server name without proving the invoked server artifact identity.
required_behavior: A configured stdio invocation digest binds a locally resolved launcher executable and local payload file content selected by the args, and is checked before all argument-dependent authorization and relay; mismatch or unresolved identity denies with identity-bound audit evidence; recognized dynamic registry launchers (npx, uvx, npm exec) are unpinnable and fail closed when attestation is configured; a matching local digest passes without false denial.
failure_behavior: Fail closed for tools/call when attestation is configured and identity resolution is missing, unsupported, or mismatched.
non_goals: attesting a process whose executable or transitive dependencies changed after measurement
identity attestation without an explicit invocation snapshot
imprecise or non-injective artifact identity encoding
attesting a server name without binding to the measured process snapshot
trusting MCP-declared server metadata as identity proof

attack_classes.expected: missing, unsupported, mismatched, stale, or mixed-generation identity attestation denies tools/call with zero relay and never reports server_attested=true
